Let’s Help Adolescents

一起帮助青少年 · 185 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Whether they are male or female, adolescents often want to make their own decisions, even when they have received instructions from their parents. This is especially true when they face issues such as sex or mental stress that may make them feel ashamed or embarrassed. With limited experience and judgement, they sometimes get into trouble without realising it. Some become addicted to cigarettes, which can damage their lungs and leave them breathless. Others find it hard to give up alcohol. Drinking alcohol while pregnant increases the risk of miscarriage and can harm the developing baby. Drug abuse is especially serious because withdrawal can be difficult once someone is dependent on a drug. Sharing needles can spread HIV, which may lead to AIDS if it is left untreated. Treatment can control HIV and help people live long, healthy lives.

2Even so, we should not be quick to feel disappointed in our children or let prejudice affect how we judge them. After all, feeling awkward is part of growing up. By strengthening communication with them instead of simply banning things, we can help them avoid harmful choices.

一起帮助青少年

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1无论男孩还是女孩，青少年都喜欢自己作决定，哪怕父母已经给过指点。遇到性、心理压力等让他们难堪或尴尬的问题时，尤其如此。由于经验有限、判断还不成熟，他们有时会在不知不觉中陷入困境。有些人染上烟瘾，吸烟会伤害肺部，还会让人容易气喘。有些人戒不掉酒。怀孕期间饮酒会增加流产的风险，也可能伤害正在发育的胎儿。药物滥用尤其严重，身体一旦产生依赖，戒断就很难。共用针具可能传播人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）。感染后若得不到治疗，可能发展为艾滋病。治疗能够控制病毒，帮助感染者健康地生活许多年。

2不过，别轻易对孩子失望，也别带着偏见看他们。毕竟，笨拙和不自在都是成长的一部分。我们多和他们沟通，少一些一味的禁止，就更能帮他们避开有害的选择。
